headline: FAA Looks at a MAX Go-Around Guidance Drop
deck: CBS reports the FAA is investigating a software glitch that can drop automated flight guidance on some 737 Max jets during a go-around. On Saturday the FAA said it is assessing the problem, will act if it finds a safety concern, and will review Boeing's proposed fix.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration is investigating a software glitch in some Boeing 737 Max jets that could prompt an automated flight guidance system to disengage during an aborted landing, commonly referred to as a go-around. [E1]
The FAA said Saturday that it is assessing the problem and will take immediate action if it identifies a safety concern, and that it will review Boeing's proposed fix. [E2]
